name: claude-mods
description: Alan Newingham's Claude Code mods: panes, bands, sounds and commands, each one data first and tested.

plugins.name: agent-roster
plugins.description: A live agent dashboard (/roster): main loop with task and steps, architect, permission gate, agents stacked as cards then swimlanes, loops, turn receipt and session log; a helper desk view with a to-do bar and per-agent tool calls and token shares; an office view of pixel avatars typing at their desks, with a card on hover.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Map the repo you are in: what it needs to run and what is missing (gaps with file:line first), then its modules, how they depend, entry points, hot spots and cycles. /atlas opens the pane; export to Markdown with mermaid and HTML.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Catches a long or rambling prompt, asks a few clarifying questions, and puts a structured rewrite (Task / Why / Guardrails / Done looks like) in the prompt box for you to review and send

plugins.name: burn
plugins.description: Session and weekly usage gauges under the prompt, cost and burn rate, a runs-out-at forecast and usage history; nudges you to spend the weekly limit before it resets, or to ease off when burning too fast.

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: An In this chat pane like Cowork's side panel: goal, to-do progress, connectors and skills used, files made, changed or read, and tool counts, each section foldable

plugins.name: chime
plugins.description: Plays a voice pack's sounds when Claude finishes, fails, needs you, compacts or starts; our own take on peon-ping

plugins.name: commit-style
plugins.description: Tells the model to write Conventional Commits: typed, imperative, short summaries, no AI attribution.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Context usage meter above the prompt: raw and usable fill with the autocompact mark, turns-to-autocompact forecast, prompt-cache countdown and miss detection, files changed on disk since read, compactions, and a FRESH/AGING/STALE/COLD verdict.

plugins.name: diff-review
plugins.description: Walk through the agent's edits hunk by hunk and keep or undo each one, then replay them by turn or file with Play/Pause, denied and failed calls included.

plugins.name: effort-picker
plugins.description: Suggests a model and effort for the prompt you are typing, with the reason and a re-caches marker; Use applies it to the next turn only

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Moves the work to a fresh chat: offers a handoff past a token threshold or when the prompt cache goes cold, writes it through a fork of the session, saves it under ~/.claude/handoffs, and clears only when you confirm, leaving the handoff in the prompt box.

plugins.name: human-gate
plugins.description: Holds irreversible tool calls (deploys, publishes, protected pushes, money, outbound messages, destructive SQL) for a person; lets read-only calls through.

plugins.name: mermaid-draw
plugins.description: Draws ```mermaid fences in assistant replies as box-drawing diagrams in the terminal transcript (flowcharts and sequence diagrams)

plugins.name: modernize
plugins.description: Understand and prove a legacy code modernization: intent, assessment, map, business rules with checked citations, a brief to approve, status, and a scripted PROVEN / PARTLY PROVEN / NOT PROVEN verdict

plugins.name: pet
plugins.description: A virtual pet above the prompt that grows from Claude's real work: tests, commits and edits.

plugins.name: rubber-duck
plugins.description: A side-panel chat with a model you pick: talk through the project, or anything else.

plugins.name: screen-share
plugins.description: Screen share mode: masks keys, tokens, env values, user paths, emails, phone numbers, money and names on screen while you present or stream, with an ON AIR mark

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: A /switchboard pane with one card per mod: what is true now, what changes at next load, and whether new panes are blocked; search, filter, keyboard, and a locked view when the switch file is broken.

plugins.name: turn-prefix
plugins.description: Start a prompt with _ to run that turn on Haiku, or + to think at max effort; shown while typing, while it runs and under the answer
